description: Get a daily time series of earnings and vault balance for a Morpho or YO vault account. Returns up to one year of UTC-day data points (timestamp, earnings, balance) plus totalEarnings and netDeposits summaries.

vaultProvider.description: Vault provider — MORPHO (Earnings) or YO (Smart Earnings)
